measurement.comparison: Previous main versus final refactor, not upstream. Native disables freeze/body certificates with identical cooperative scheduling and source index.

measurement.diagnostic: Same dispatch through matching edited-file version publication; overlaps query and is not global completion.
measurement.continuous: Six serial awaited body edits per process, then process medians; no burst or p99 claim.
measurement.memory: Boundary RSS, current physical footprint, lifetime peak physical footprint. Peak includes rebuild and recovery.
measurement.manualRebuildMs: Command reply interval only; not total rebuild through subsequent analysis.
measurement.scope: Requested freeze, prepared closure, actual fixed-root import and local body reuse are distinct.
measurement.scale: Class counts are lexical declarations in loaded physical HDL. Hierarchy counts group instantiated module/interface symbols by definition name.
